stops.meaning: a member of the trading caste

stops.note: Arab traders adopted the word for the Hindu merchants they dealt with
Portuguese traders at Persian Gulf ports used the term
applied first to the merchants, then to the fig tree they traded and sheltered beneath at a Gulf port
stops.meaning: the sacred fig tree with aerial roots

current_meaning: A large fig tree native to India that grows aerial roots from its branches, forming multiple trunks.
